code: set.seed(1) n  <- 300 x1 <- rnorm(n) df <- data.frame(y = 2 * x1 + rnorm(n), x1 = x1,                  x2 = rnorm(n), noise = rnorm(n))  fit <- boot_select(df, y ~ x1 + x2 + noise, fit_linear,                    n_rep = 50, seed = 42)  # x1 and x2 stand in for a correlated pair -- weight and body surface area, # say. n_any is not the sum of their individual counts: a replicate that # selected both counts once. boot_clusters(fit, list(size = c("x1", "x2"), noise = "noise")) #>   cluster n_any pct_any members #> 1    size    50     100  x1, x2 #> 2   noise    13      26   noise
